definitions.explanation: A colorful bell pepper, typically red, yellow, or orange. In Japanese, パプリカ specifically refers to the thick-fleshed, sweet varieties imported or grown for salads and cooking, distinguishing them from the thinner-walled ピーマン.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧パプリカ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I added red bell pepper to the salad.

examples.japanese: パプリカ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ピーマン→ピーマン：11132_piiman⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{甘|あま}くて→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{食|た}べやすい→食べやすい：21799_tabeyasui⟧。
examples.english: Bell peppers are sweeter and easier to eat than green peppers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧パプリカ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧パプリカ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using yellow and red bell peppers makes the dish look more colorful.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese, パプリカ and ⟦ピーマン→ピーマン：11132_piiman⟧ refer to different things. ⟦ピーマン→ピーマン：11132_piiman⟧ is the smaller, thinner-walled green pepper common in Japanese cooking. パプリカ refers to the larger, thicker, sweeter varieties (typically red, yellow, or orange). Both are types of bell pepper in English.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パプリカ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉詰|にくづ}め (stuffed bell pepper)
- パプリカ⟦パウダー→パウダー：23869_paudaa⟧ (paprika powder — the spice)
- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧パプリカ / ⟦{黄|き}→黄：19352_ki⟧パプリカ (red / yellow bell pepper)
